evidence.detail: parse_season raises InvalidValueException(f"Could not get a Penny Dreadful season from '{term}'") — verbose message
MAX_PUBLIC_ERROR_LENGTH = 200 with truncation already applied for Discord bot — Discord display is already handled
Web UI: card_search_where catches InvalidSearchException and returns str(e) as display message with no truncation
6 InvalidSearchException subclasses (InvalidTokenException, InvalidModeException, InvalidValueException, InvalidCriterionException etc.) all have verbose messages — systematic change needed

triage.notes: The issue proposes adding a short_message field to InvalidSearchException to enforce short messages at write time. This requires updating the exception class hierarchy in find/search.py, all 8+ raise sites, and the web UI template/display code — broader than an easy-fix. Alternatively, truncation could be added to the decksite display layer, but the issue author prefers the short_message approach.
